section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 23, Skattmansöådalen-Härnevi IP
section.notes: Runs from Ytterkvarn/Skattmansöådalen through forest, small roads, Torstuna/Torslundagropen/Vånsjöåsen and onward to Härnevi IP.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 23 GPX as primary geometry.
Reverse raw GPX for written Skattmansöådalen-to-Härnevi IP direction.
Preserve five segments; the extra short segments around Ytterkvarn/Skattmansöådalen should not be collapsed without visual review.
Etapp 23 hands off to Etapp 24 at Härnevi IP.
qa: Computed segmented length 19.909 km matches official 20 km.
Etapp 23 shares Ytterkvarn with Etapp 22 and Härnevi IP with Etapp 24.

iterationLog.sourceReview: Highest-confidence rows are endpoint clusters and Torstuna water. Mid-route rest places from the official facility list remain medium-confidence until object coordinates are found.
